name: sleek-line-cursor
title: Sleek Line Cursor
description: A single hair-thin stroke is pulled along behind the mouse by a spring, so it swoops and loops rather than tracking exactly. Its colour drifts slowly through hues over a dark stage.
use: A portfolio or creative landing page that wants a subtle, distinctive pointer flourish over a dark hero.
avoid: Runs a full-screen fixed canvas with global listeners, is faint at 1px, and offers nothing on keyboard or touch.
a11y: Decorative pointer effect with no reduced-motion check, so the constant full-screen animation keeps running for motion-sensitive users. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Almost nothing sits on the black stage except a thin bordered rectangle holding a line of pale text. Across it runs one hair-thin curved stroke in a dim pinkish red, following the moving pointer. The rest of the frame is empty black.
behaves: The stroke is a chain of points pulled toward the cursor by a spring, so it lags, overshoots and curls into loops like a loose thread. Its hue cycles slowly, and it redraws every frame over the cleared canvas.
customise: Tune the number of trail lines, spring friction, node count, dampening and tension as props; the hue range and stroke opacity are written into the source.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop updates about a thousand spring nodes every frame across the window.
demo: A dark bordered panel with the text Move your mouse to see the cursor trail effect.
issues: The 1px line is very faint against black.
Prevents default on pointer moves, which can block scrolling on touch devices.
polishWhy: Subtle and smooth, but the line is so faint it barely registers as a custom cursor.
